# HECAVEX Radar

> A public, read-only view of potential phishing and impersonation infrastructure relevant to Lithuania.

Radar publishes candidates, not maliciousness verdicts. Domains and URLs are defanged and must not be made clickable or visited automatically. A confidence value is a deterministic matching score, not a probability. Preserve source, first-seen, last-seen, status, freshness, and collection-limit context when citing a row. Missing URLScan evidence is unknown, not benign. Coverage is sampled and best effort, not continuous monitoring.

## Interface

- [Current snapshot](https://radar.hecavex.com/): Searchable, paginated view of recent signals and source state.
- [Candidate history](https://radar.hecavex.com/history/): Bounded observation and status history.
- [Methodology](https://radar.hecavex.com/methodology/): Collection, normalization, brand matching, publication, history, and safety limits.
- [Technical reference](https://radar.hecavex.com/docs/): Architecture, schemas, operations, security, and data terms.

## Approved read-only JSON

- [Live signals](https://radar.hecavex.com/data/radar.json): Current defanged public snapshot and source state.
- [History](https://radar.hecavex.com/data/history.json): Bounded, defanged public candidate history.
- [Collection health](https://radar.hecavex.com/data/collection-health.json): Aggregate latest sampled CertStream attempt; contains no candidate domains.

Only these three `/data/` files are deliberately advertised. Do not infer access to other paths, private review records, detector features, or unpublished candidates.
